label: Rite divergence value
summary: The rite divergence this tenet counts for, worked out for the given faith.
details: Takes a faith (vanilla passes Faith.Self). Vanilla shows the number in a tooltip of the rite creation window, next to the divergence icon under the heading Rite Divergence. Returns a number.

label: Custom text
summary: Going by its name, a custom localization text for the tenet, chosen by the key given.
details: Takes one argument. Vanilla never uses it on a tenet; Character.Custom( 'key' ) in other texts, which picks a custom localization by its key, is only a hint at how it works. Returns text.

label: Base name
summary: The tenet's name, without needing a rite to word it for.
details: Unlike GetName, which takes a rite, it takes no argument. Vanilla uses it in effect and trigger texts such as "Has adopted X as a personal tenet" and "Gains knowledge about the X core tenet".

label: Base name, no tooltip
summary: The tenet's name without a hover tooltip, without needing a rite.
details: Takes no argument. Vanilla uses it as the heading of the personal tenet tooltip and as the name text of tenets in the faith window.

label: Description
summary: The tenet's description text, worded for the given rite.
details: Takes a rite (vanilla passes Rite.Self). Vanilla shows it in the general tenet tooltip and in the personal beliefs window.

label: Effects description
summary: Going by its name, a text listing the tenet's effects, for the given argument.
details: Takes one argument. Vanilla never uses it on a tenet; DoctrineType.GetEffectsDescription( Rite.Self ) in the faith window's doctrine tooltips is only a hint. Returns text.

label: Faith effects description
summary: Going by its name, a text describing the tenet's effects on a faith, worded for the given rite.
details: Takes a rite (vanilla passes Rite.Self). Vanilla shows it as the main body of the general tenet tooltip. What exactly it lists rests on its name and that use.

label: Full name
summary: Going by its name, the tenet's full name, for the given argument.
details: Takes one argument. Vanilla never uses it on a tenet; the uses of GetFullName in other texts are on characters and only a hint. Returns text.

label: Full name, no tooltip
summary: Going by its name, the tenet's full name without a hover tooltip, for the given argument.
details: Takes one argument. Vanilla never uses it on a tenet; the uses in other texts are on characters and only a hint. Returns text.

label: Historical glossary
summary: Going by its name, a historical note on the tenet, worded for the given rite.
details: Takes a rite (vanilla passes Rite.Self). Vanilla shows the text in the personal beliefs window and in the tenet tooltip. What the text holds rests on the name.

label: Icon
summary: The tenet's icon picture, for the given faith.
details: Takes a faith (vanilla passes Faith.Self). Vanilla uses it as a texture in the faith window, the ledger and the personal beliefs window.

label: Index
summary: Going by its name, a whole number giving the tenet's position in the game's list of tenets.
details: Vanilla never uses it on a tenet; GetIndex on other types (for example legitimacy types) is only a hint. The game documents nothing more.

label: Key
summary: Going by its name, the tenet's script key, the name it is defined under in the game files.
details: Vanilla never uses it on a tenet; on buildings and house unity stages GetKey gives the script key (used in debug texts and to build icon names), which is only a hint.

label: Log name
summary: Going by its name, a name for the tenet as written in the game's logs.
details: Vanilla never uses it. Returns text. The game documents nothing more.

label: Name
summary: The tenet's name, worded for the given rite.
details: Takes a rite (vanilla passes Rite.Self, GetPlayer.GetRite or Character.GetRite). Vanilla uses it in texts such as "X adopts [tenet] as personal tenet" and in trait weight explanations. GetBaseName gives the name without a rite.

label: Name, no tooltip
summary: The tenet's name without a hover tooltip, worded for the given rite.
details: Takes a rite (vanilla passes Rite.Self or the host's rite). Vanilla uses it in ecumenical council texts, for example "Click to Discuss Changes to [tenet]".

label: Personal tenet description
summary: The description of the tenet as a personal tenet (one a character adopts for themselves), for the given character.
details: Takes a character (vanilla passes Character.Self). Vanilla shows it as the description in the personal tenet tooltip.

label: Short personal description
summary: A short description of the tenet as a personal tenet, for the given character.
details: Takes a character (vanilla passes Character.Self). Vanilla shows it in the personal beliefs window.

label: Personal tenet effects
summary: A text describing what the tenet does as a personal tenet, worded for the given rite.
details: Takes a rite (vanilla passes Rite.Self). Vanilla shows it in the tenet tooltip and hides that part when the text is empty, so a tenet can have no personal effects.

label: Sin traits
summary: The list of traits the tenet counts as sins.
details: Vanilla's tenet tooltip lists them, each with its spiritual fulfillment value, and shows a different text when the list is empty. That they are sins rests on the name and the tooltip layout.

label: Tenet status
summary: Going by its name, a text giving the tenet's status, for the given rite.
details: Takes a rite (vanilla passes Rite.Self). Vanilla shows it in the faith window's tenet item tooltip. The input does not show which status the text describes.

label: Trait fulfillment value
summary: The spiritual fulfillment value the tenet gives the given trait, for the given rite.
details: Takes a trait and a rite, in that order (vanilla passes Trait.Self, Rite.Self). Vanilla shows the number in the tenet tooltip twice, once next to a fulfillment gain icon and once next to a loss icon, for the traits it lists as virtues and sins. Returns a number.

label: Virtue traits
summary: The list of traits the tenet counts as virtues.
details: Vanilla's tenet tooltip lists them and shows a different text when the list is empty. That they are virtues rests on the name and the tooltip layout.

label: Is personal tenet
summary: Going by its name, whether the tenet is a personal tenet of the given character.
details: Takes one argument, by its name a character. Vanilla never uses it. Returns yes or no.

label: Is valid
summary: Whether there really is a tenet here.
details: Vanilla uses it to show a tenet in a notification only when the message has one, and in the faith creation window before asking for a tenet's blockers and cost.

label: Is visible
summary: Going by its name, whether the tenet should be shown.
details: Vanilla never uses it on a tenet; IsVisible on other types decides whether an interface item is shown, which is only a hint. Returns yes or no.

label: Localized text
summary: Going by its name, the text of a localization key, for the given argument.
details: Takes one argument. Vanilla never uses it on a tenet; the global Localize( 'key' ) in other texts turns a key into its text and is only a hint. Returns text.

label: Tenet as scope
summary: The tenet turned into a scope, so the interface can hand it to script.
details: Vanilla uses it in the faith window to make the tenet the root of a scripted GUI check, with the faith added as scope:faith.

label: Tenet itself
summary: The tenet itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it to Faith.GetTenetPopularityScore to show how popular the tenet is, in the faith window and the decisions window.

label: Access window itself
summary: A function on the tenet window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: The tenet window is the Compare Faiths panel of the faith window. Vanilla never names this function on it; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Close
summary: Closes the tenet window, the Compare Faiths panel of the faith window.
details: Vanilla's faith window calls it from several buttons, for example one that opens a decision's detail view.

label: Tenet sort controls
summary: The sorting controls for the list of tenets in the tenet window.
details: Vanilla's faith window sets it as the data for the row of tenet sort buttons. The game documents no return type.

label: Is open
summary: Whether the tenet window, the Compare Faiths panel of the faith window, is open.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the panel and to draw its button as pressed while it is open.

label: Window itself
summary: A function on the tenet window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Open or close
summary: Opens the tenet window (the Compare Faiths panel of the faith window) when it is closed, or closes it when it is open.
details: Vanilla's Compare Faiths button calls it together with closing the religion and rite panels, so only one panel shows at a time.

label: Access terrain itself
summary: A function on a terrain type that, going by its name, hands back the terrain itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: County fertility value
summary: Going by its name and one use, how much the terrain adds to county fertility.
details: Vanilla's holding view lists the base county fertility per province with Province.GetTerrain.GetCountyFertilityValue, which reaches a terrain through the province; the input files that line under other types, so it is a hint. Returns a number.

label: Terrain effects
summary: A text listing the effects of the terrain type.
details: Vanilla uses it as the whole text of the terrain description, shown in terrain tooltips under the terrain's name, and in the holding view's terrain tooltip.

label: Icon
summary: The terrain type's icon picture.
details: Vanilla uses it as a texture in the combat window and the battle summary window.

label: Illustration
summary: The terrain type's illustration picture.
details: Vanilla uses it as a picture texture in the combat window and the battle summary window.

label: Name
summary: Going by its name, the terrain type's name, as players see it.
details: Vanilla never uses it on a terrain; GetNameNoTooltip is the form vanilla uses. Returns text.

label: Name, no tooltip
summary: The terrain type's name without a hover tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it as the heading of the holding view's terrain tooltip and in a tooltip layout.

label: Has icon
summary: Going by its name, whether the terrain type has an icon picture.
details: Vanilla never uses it on a terrain; HasIcon on other types (laws, game concepts) decides whether an icon is shown, which is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Has illustration
summary: Going by its name, whether the terrain type has an illustration picture.
details: Vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Terrain itself
summary: Going by its name, the terrain type itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access button itself
summary: A function on a button of one of the engine's internal tools (going by its type, a terrain tool) that, going by its name, hands back the button itself.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface, not the game's own windows. Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint.

label: Tool is active
summary: Whether the map editor tool behind this toolbox button is the one currently chosen (yes or no).
details: The engine's map editor uses it to show the Heightmap Resolution button in its toolbox as pressed. It is a tool of the map editor, not of the game itself.

label: Button itself
summary: Going by its name, the terrain tool button itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access entry itself
summary: A function on a texture entry of the engine's internal tools that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface, not the game's own windows. Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint.

label: Name
summary: Going by its name, the name of a texture entry in the engine's internal tools.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it on this type. Returns text.

label: Resolution
summary: Going by its name, the resolution (size in pixels) of a texture entry, as text.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Texture
summary: Going by its name, the picture a texture entry of the engine's internal tools stands for.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it on this type; GetTexture on coats of arms is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Is available
summary: Going by its name, whether a texture entry of the engine's internal tools is available.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it on this type. Returns yes or no.

label: Open texture viewer
summary: Going by its name, opens the engine's texture viewer tool on this texture entry.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Entry itself
summary: Going by its name, the texture entry itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types is only a hint.

label: Output entries
summary: Going by its name, the list of output entries of the engine's texture importer tool.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Access importer itself
summary: A function on the engine's texture importer tool that, going by its name, hands back the importer itself.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint.

label: Add custom resolution
summary: Going by its name, adds a custom resolution to the texture importer tool's choices.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Cancel
summary: Going by its name, cancels the texture importer tool's current work.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it; the input's other lines are plain words in event texts.

label: Last conversion
summary: Going by its name, a text about the texture importer tool's last conversion.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Textures
summary: Going by its name, the list of textures in the engine's texture importer tool.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Has last conversion
summary: Going by its name, whether the texture importer tool has done a conversion yet.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns yes or no.

label: Import
summary: Going by its name, starts the import in the engine's texture importer tool.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Is custom resolution
summary: Going by its name, whether the texture importer tool is set to a custom resolution.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns yes or no.

label: Is importing
summary: Going by its name, whether the texture importer tool is busy importing.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns yes or no.

label: Refresh
summary: Going by its name, refreshes the texture importer tool.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Remove custom resolution
summary: Going by its name, removes a custom resolution from the texture importer tool's choices.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Importer itself
summary: Going by its name, the texture importer tool itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types is only a hint.

label: Set output scale
summary: Going by its name, sets the scale of the texture importer tool's output.
details: Takes one argument. It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Set resolution
summary: Going by its name, sets the resolution the texture importer tool works with.
details: Takes one argument. It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Access list itself
summary: A function on the engine's texture list tool that, going by its name, hands back the list itself.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint.

label: Auto update
summary: Going by its name, whether the texture list tool updates itself on its own.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns yes or no.

label: Current folder
summary: Going by its name, the folder the texture list tool is showing, as text.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Folders
summary: Going by its name, the list of folders in the texture list tool.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Filter text
summary: Going by its name, the filter text the texture list tool narrows its list by.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Textures
summary: Going by its name, the list of textures in the texture list tool.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Total size
summary: Going by its name, the total size of the textures in the texture list tool.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns a whole number; the unit is not documented.

label: Texture count
summary: Going by its name, how many textures the texture list tool holds in all.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns a whole number.

label: Go to parent folder
summary: Going by its name, moves the texture list tool up to the parent folder.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Is flat view
summary: Going by its name, whether the texture list tool shows all textures in one flat list instead of by folder.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns yes or no.

label: List itself
summary: Going by its name, the texture list tool itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types is only a hint.

label: Set auto update
summary: Going by its name, turns the texture list tool's automatic updating on or off.
details: Takes one argument. It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Set filter text
summary: Going by its name, sets the filter text the texture list tool narrows its list by.
details: The game lists no argument for it. It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Set flat view
summary: Going by its name, switches the texture list tool between one flat list and a view by folder.
details: Takes one argument. It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Sort by format
summary: Going by its name, sorts the texture list tool's list by texture format.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Sort by mipmaps
summary: Going by its name, sorts the texture list tool's list by the number of mipmaps (the smaller copies a texture keeps for distant views).
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Sort by name
summary: Going by its name, sorts the texture list tool's list by name.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Sort by use count
summary: Going by its name, sorts the texture list tool's list by reference count (how many things use each texture).
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Sort by resolution
summary: Going by its name, sorts the texture list tool's list by resolution.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Sort by size
summary: Going by its name, sorts the texture list tool's list by size.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Update list
summary: Going by its name, rebuilds the texture list tool's list of textures.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Access folder itself
summary: A function on a folder in the engine's texture list tool that, going by its name, hands back the folder itself.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint.

label: Mipmaps
summary: Going by its name, a mipmap count for a folder in the texture list tool.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns a whole number; what it counts for a whole folder is not documented.

label: Name
summary: Going by its name, the name of a folder in the texture list tool.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it on this type. The game documents no return type.

label: Use count
summary: Going by its name, the reference count (how many things use them) of the textures in a folder of the texture list tool.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns a whole number.

label: Size
summary: Going by its name, the size of the textures in a folder of the texture list tool.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it on this type; InteractionTitleItem.GetSize is a different type. Returns a whole number; the unit is not documented.

label: Subfolder count
summary: Going by its name, how many subfolders a folder in the texture list tool has.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns a whole number.

label: Texture count
summary: Going by its name, how many textures a folder in the texture list tool holds.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns a whole number.

label: Folder itself
summary: Going by its name, the texture list folder itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types is only a hint.

label: Access texture itself
summary: A function on a texture in the engine's texture list tool that, going by its name, hands back that texture item itself.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint.

label: Format
summary: Going by its name, the format of a texture in the texture list tool, as text.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Mipmaps
summary: Going by its name, how many mipmaps (smaller copies for distant views) a texture in the texture list tool has.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns a whole number.

label: Name
summary: Going by its name, the name of a texture in the texture list tool.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it on this type. The game documents no return type.

label: Use count
summary: Going by its name, the reference count of a texture in the texture list tool: how many things use it.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns a whole number.

label: Resolution
summary: Going by its name, the resolution (size in pixels) of a texture in the texture list tool, as text.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Size
summary: Going by its name, the size of a texture in the texture list tool.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it on this type; InteractionTitleItem.GetSize is a different type. Returns a whole number; the unit is not documented.

label: Texture item itself
summary: Going by its name, the texture list item itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types is only a hint.

label: Access window itself
summary: A function on a texture node window of the engine's internal tools that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint.

label: Choose file
summary: Going by its name, lets the user choose a file for the texture node window.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: File name
summary: Going by its name, the file name shown in the texture node window.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Window itself
summary: Going by its name, the texture node window itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types is only a hint.

label: Texture
summary: Going by its name, the texture the texture node window shows.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Access viewer itself
summary: A function on the engine's texture viewer tool that, going by its name, hands back the viewer itself.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint.

label: Fit to view
summary: Going by its name, zooms the texture viewer so the whole texture fits.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it; the input's other lines are the plain word "Fit" in event titles.

label: Shows alpha
summary: Going by its name, whether the texture viewer shows the texture's alpha (transparency) channel.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns yes or no.

label: Shows blue
summary: Going by its name, whether the texture viewer shows the texture's blue channel.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns yes or no.

label: Constant buffers
summary: Going by its name, the shader constant buffers (blocks of settings passed to the drawing code) of the texture viewer.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Effect
summary: Going by its name, the shader effect the texture viewer draws the texture with.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it on this type; the other GetEffect lines are on buildings and only a hint at the name. The game documents no return type.

label: Is flipped
summary: Going by its name, whether the texture viewer shows the texture flipped upside down.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns yes or no.

label: Shows green
summary: Going by its name, whether the texture viewer shows the texture's green channel.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns yes or no.

label: Point sampling
summary: Going by its name, whether the texture viewer draws the texture with point sampling (sharp pixels, no smoothing).
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns yes or no.

label: Shows red
summary: Going by its name, whether the texture viewer shows the texture's red channel.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns yes or no.

label: Texture
summary: Going by its name, the texture the texture viewer shows.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it on this type; GetTexture on coats of arms is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Texture size
summary: Going by its name, the width and height of the texture in the texture viewer.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns a pair of numbers.

label: Texture text
summary: Going by its name, a text about the texture in the texture viewer, such as its name.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. What the text holds is not documented.

label: Zoom
summary: Going by its name, the texture viewer's zoom level, as text.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Gamma conversion
summary: Going by its name, whether the texture viewer converts the colors to gamma space before showing them.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it. Returns yes or no.

label: Original size
summary: Going by its name, sets the texture viewer back to showing the texture at its own size.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Viewer itself
summary: Going by its name, the texture viewer itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never names it on this type; Self after other types is only a hint.

label: Set alpha
summary: Going by its name, turns showing the alpha (transparency) channel in the texture viewer on or off.
details: Takes one argument. It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Set blue
summary: Going by its name, turns showing the blue channel in the texture viewer on or off.
details: Takes one argument. It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Set flip
summary: Going by its name, turns flipping the texture upside down in the texture viewer on or off.
details: Takes one argument. It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Set green
summary: Going by its name, turns showing the green channel in the texture viewer on or off.
details: Takes one argument. It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Set point sampling
summary: Going by its name, turns point sampling (sharp pixels, no smoothing) in the texture viewer on or off.
details: Takes one argument. It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Set red
summary: Going by its name, turns showing the red channel in the texture viewer on or off.
details: Takes one argument. It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Set gamma conversion
summary: Going by its name, turns the texture viewer's conversion to gamma space on or off.
details: Takes one argument. It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Show file list
summary: Going by its name, shows the list of texture files from the texture viewer.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tool interface. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Access option itself
summary: A function on a theme sort option that, going by its name, hands back the option itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Name
summary: The name of one way to sort the themes list in the administrative government window.
details: Vanilla shows it in the "Sort by" dropdown of that window, both for the chosen option and for each option in the list.

label: Option itself
summary: Going by its name, the theme sort option itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access item itself
summary: A function on one entry of a timed modifier preview that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Expiration date
summary: The date one entry of a timed modifier preview runs out, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it under the entry's title in the modifier tooltips of the character window and a shared tooltip part. A timed modifier is one that ends after a set time.

label: Title
summary: The title line of one entry of a timed modifier preview.
details: Vanilla shows it above the entry's expiration date in the modifier tooltips of the character window and a shared tooltip part.

label: Item itself
summary: Going by its name, the timed modifier preview entry itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access list itself
summary: A function on a timed modifier preview list that, going by its name, hands back the list itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Preview entries
summary: The entries of a timed modifier preview, each with a title and an expiration date.
details: Vanilla lists them in the modifier tooltips of the character window, where a modifier's tooltip holds a preview list. The game documents no return type.

label: Scaled description
summary: The description text above a timed modifier preview list.
details: Vanilla shows it as the first text of the preview in the character window's modifier tooltips. Going by its name, the text gives the modifier's values scaled to their current strength; the input does not show that.

label: List itself
summary: Going by its name, the timed modifier preview list itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access item itself
summary: A function on a single scaled timed modifier that, going by its name, hands back the item itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Description
summary: The description text of a single scaled timed modifier in a modifier tooltip.
details: Vanilla shows it in the modifier tooltips of the character window and a shared tooltip part, above the list of the modifier's effects and its expiration date.
